With taller &thicker design, NICEED Lumbar support pillow for office chair from a greater surface area, including stiffness and tension in the mid- and lower-back region. The contoured shape supports your back's curve for proper spinal alignment and to promote posture. 100% memory foam cushion
lumbar support for car has 3D mesh breathable design that offers support and comfort for ergogenic positioning,regulate temperatureand. A fabrication known for cushion and bounce, memory foam holds your lower back in proper posture. 3D ergonomic design
One main lower breathable mesh part. Extra thick and wide. our ergonomic pillow is made to fit the spine’s curve and the body’s form. Two higher parts on two sides gently hold front your waist. The impression-making effect of memory foam will also take pressure off your spine Application Fields
This seat pillow is suitable for office chair, car seat, wheelchair,recliner, gaming chair, any home chair or seat on a bus, airplane or train. And backrest pads is suitable for drivers, teachers, students, people need wheelchair, pregnant women, office workers etc. Reliable customer serviceTips:
Since it's temperature sense memory foam cushion, it's normal that cushions become harder in low temperature, cushion's softness will be adjusted by user or ambient temperature

items: 【UNIQUE UPDATED JOINT BREATHABLE & 3D MESH COVER】 - With removable and machine washable mesh cover, this support pillow can keep air circulation well and always keep you back cool and comfortable, dry for the experience, so sweat doesn’t fill it up, suitable for all seasons. The back suede material enables the back cushion suitable for all year round

【Comfortable Lumbar support pillow for office chair / car】 If you spend a lot of time sitting on office chair and driving in car, this back cushion will help you. It is designed ergonomically to relieve upper, mid and lower back pain and back tightness, support you to achieve a posture and helps maintain the curve of the spine

【Memory foam Support for Back and Lumbar & Suitable for All People】Memory foam backrest with soft fabric backing keeps shape and can be reused. Comes the elasticity, which makes our product support your back in a proper posture. Our product with designed curve and waist embracing design, hold your back all the time. The size for office workers, pregnant, drivers and students to improve their posture

【NEVER FLAT】Orthopedic Backrest with adjustable elastic straps design ensuring back cushions stays on the seat without any slipping or sliding. Whether you are driving a car, lying on the couch, watching TV, playing video games, or studying and even working, Villsure Lumbar Support Pillow is the one specially designed for you. Its thoughtful care, smooth curve, elegant appearance, let you linger
【Pillow for Friends and Families】This lumbar support cushion is a comfortable pillow for parents,office staff,teachers,drivers,students who sit for a long time

【Adjustable straps】The straps are adjustable from shortest length 19 inches to longest length 50 inches, which can fit most of office chair and car seats. But please note that some big sofa or chairs may not suitable. Please kindly check whether the strap size fits your chairs

【Q&A】Memory foam lumbar support pillow will fit your back after 7 days. Please don't worry if you feel little not comfortable, or little firm or soft, little thick or thin when you receive it. Because the temperature during transportation affects the hardness of memory foam. And they will back to original softness base on your temperature after you use it for few times
【Product Size】16.31"*17.94"*4.69". Please kindly check the product size before purchase
